name: Local YDB MCP
tagline: Operate Docker-based local YDB deployments with plan-first safety gates
description: Inspect, bootstrap, diagnose, harden, migrate, and upgrade configured local YDB deployments locally or over SSH. Mutating tools return a plan first and execute only when `confirm: true` is supplied.

env.name: LOCAL_YDB_TOOLKIT_CONFIG
env.description: Absolute path to a local-ydb-toolkit config JSON file

env.name: LOCAL_YDB_MCP_CONTENT_FORMAT
env.description: Optional response text format: json or toon

install.notes: Requires Node.js 20.19 or newer plus npm/npx. Do not paste credentials into marketplace fields; keep them in local config or password files and pass an absolute config path.
